systems.owner: National Social Safety-Nets Coordinating Office (NASSCO), under the Federal Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction
systems.tiers: a national register whose records are updated across 774 local government areas, 8,756 wards and over 217,000 communities; local government chairmen are asked to drive NIN integration

note: The register is a federal office's; the document calls local governments partners in verification and delivery but does not say any local government office is connected or works in the register.
